CD-NOD.assumption: domain/time index is observed and separated from endogenous measured context

Nonstationary linear SEM.assumption: fully observed linear instantaneous acyclic SEM with theorem-level coefficient/noise assumptions

TDRL.assumption: finite discrete first-order Markov domain state with known domain variable and full-rank variation

CtrlNS.assumption: mechanism-separable changing support with sufficient variation and bounded model complexity

IDOL.assumption: sparse latent process and justified instantaneous/lagged parent sets

CaRiNG.assumption: non-invertible observation assumptions and independent latent dynamics/noise

LEAP.assumption: independent mechanism noise and identifiable temporal latent process assumptions
